svg.desc: Before, pending edit-stack items forced the full work queue panel to stay open. After, pending work only marks the Queue button active; the full panel opens on demand and can collapse while items remain.
svg.text: PR #2102 - Make session work queue collapsible
Pending annotation work no longer forces the full queue panel open.
The top rail keeps the count; the user controls expansion.

g.text: work_queue_expanded
panel_open || pending_work_count > 0 || error
Any pending item made aria-expanded true and
kept the full queue list visible above input.
work_queue_active
panel_open || pending_or_error_attention
Pending work still colors Queue N in the top rail,
but aria-expanded now follows panel_open only.
render_edit_stack_panel
The renderer returned a full section whenever
pending was non-empty, even after Hide.
The panel could not stay collapsed with work queued.
panel renders only when open
If panel_open is false and there is no error,
pending items stay hidden behind the top-rail button.
Errors still surface instead of disappearing silently.
Close control only on empty queues
The x button appeared only after pending work drained,
so a long queue had no direct collapse affordance.
Always-available Collapse
The expanded panel now includes a Collapse action
whether the queue is empty, pending, or busy.

svg.text: Scope: frontend visibility and controls only; queue storage, dispatch, and annotation payloads are unchanged.
